   163	def set_key(
   164	    dotenv_path: StrPath,
   165	    key_to_set: str,
   166	    value_to_set: str,
   167	    quote_mode: str = "always",
   168	    export: bool = False,
   169	    encoding: Optional[str] = "utf-8",
   170	) -> Tuple[Optional[bool], str, str]:
   171	    """
   172	    Adds or Updates a key/value to the given .env
   173	
   174	    If the .env path given doesn't exist, fails instead of risking creating
   175	    an orphan .env somewhere in the filesystem
   176	    """
   177	    if quote_mode not in ("always", "auto", "never"):
   178	        raise ValueError(f"Unknown quote_mode: {quote_mode}")
   179	
   180	    quote = quote_mode == "always" or (
   181	        quote_mode == "auto" and not value_to_set.isalnum()
   182	    )
   183	
   184	    if quote:
   185	        value_out = "'{}'".format(
   186	            value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
   187	        )
   188	    else:
   189	        value_out = value_to_set
   190	    if export:
   191	        line_out = f"export {key_to_set}={value_out}\n"
   192	    else:
   193	        line_out = f"{key_to_set}={value_out}\n"
   194	
   195	    with rewrite(dotenv_path, encoding=encoding) as (source, dest):
   196	        replaced = False
   197	        missing_newline = False
   198	        for mapping in with_warn_for_invalid_lines(parse_stream(source)):
   199	            if mapping.key == key_to_set:
   200	                dest.write(line_out)
   201	                replaced = True
   202	            else:
   203	                dest.write(mapping.original.string)
   204	                missing_newline = not mapping.original.string.endswith("\n")
   205	        if not replaced:
   206	            if missing_newline:
   207	                dest.write("\n")
   208	            dest.write(line_out)
